scripts.tutorial:start: npm run wp:start && npm run dev
scripts.tutorial:setup: npm install && npm run wp:start && npm run wp:db:import
scripts.tutorial:prune: npm run wp:destroy && npm run tutorial:setup && npm run tutorial:start
scripts.wp:db:query: wp-env run cli -- wp db query
scripts.wp:db:export: wp-env run cli -- wp db export /var/www/html/db/database.sql
scripts.wp:db:import: wp-env run cli -- wp db import /var/www/html/db/database.sql
